g.text: Drawn to a log scale -- the gaps matter more than the exact values
RAM is roughly 1,000x faster than an SSD random read (100 ns vs 100,000 ns).
A same-datacenter round trip is roughly 300x faster than a cross-continent one (0.5 ms vs 150 ms).
The gap, not the absolute number, is what should drive a caching or CDN decision.
